title: motion-anything: chat-native motion engine with 403 recipes and Lottie/MP4 export
summary: Open-source nexu-io motion-anything repo: describe motion in chat, edit on a live page via eight agent engines, export JSON/CSS/React/Lottie/MP4/GIF, and ship portable skills with 403 curated recipes and zero npm deps.
